text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text:
Awakened from a long slumber, only to face us in battle...
I feel sorry for that superweapon... Teehee.
text_block_list.orig_text:
長い眠りから目覚めて早々、
私たちに出会ってしまうとは
運がございませんわね……
クスクス。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Agreed. But that's no reason to go easy on it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
同感ね。
けど、
手心は加えてあげないわよ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Let's carve our anger into every nook and cranny of its body.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちの怒りを、
そのバカでかい身体で食らってもらわないとね。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Annie-girl!
You wanna blow that thing to bits with me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
行こうよアンナたそ！
きっつい一撃をお見舞いしちゃおう！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text:
Need you even ask?! With our powers combined, we will shatter
the dark ambitions of villainkind!
text_block_list.orig_text:
無論そのつもりだ！
我々の力で、
邪悪な野望を完膚なきまでに打ち砕く！！
